# Falling is prevented, and the robot keeps taking orders afterwards.
# Expected output:
#   4,4,NORTH
#   4,4,EAST
#   0,0,SOUTH
PLACE 4,4,NORTH
MOVE            # ignored: north edge
MOVE            # ignored again
REPORT
RIGHT
MOVE            # ignored: east edge
REPORT
PLACE 0,0,SOUTH
MOVE            # ignored: south edge
LEFT
LEFT
RIGHT
RIGHT
REPORT
